record.question: On a medication label, a pictogram is used for which of the following purpose:
options: To replace a drug name on the medication label.
To indicate the price of the medication.
To help patients understand special instructions such as, "Do not crush".
To show the pharmacist's registration number.
record.explanation: Answer C: To help patients understand special instructions such as, "Do not crush".. A medication pictogram communicates special instructions or warnings in a visual form, such as not crushing a dosage form. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/ensuring-safe-use-medicine/medication-guides. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
